sources.title: Lemon README
sources.locator: overview table; Quick start; Reach it from anywhere; Put it on autopilot; Status
sources.finding: Elixir/OTP daemon coding agent: TUI, browser workspace, scripted -p runs, Tern, Telegram, Discord clients on one runtime; Lemon Bot browser/Mac/iOS product; kanban worktrees; cron, heartbeats, goals (preview); any model incl. ChatGPT/Claude subscription sign-in; MIT; pre-1.0.

sources.title: Support boundaries
sources.locator: Supported for 1.0; Channel Support; Automation and Cron; Not Supported for 1.0
sources.finding: Stable: TUI, Web UI, control plane, Telegram/Discord text channels, source and Linux x86_64 release tarballs; preview: goals, kanban, cron, browser automation, LSP, checkpoints, media; native Windows and hosted service not supported; terminal access runs as the host account (line ~194).

sources.title: Is Lemon right for you?
sources.finding: States no managed hosted service or native desktop app, Windows outside support, credentials not kept from tools, cron/goals lack production guarantees.

sources.title: Architecture overview
sources.locator: Message journey; Execution placement; Application responsibilities
sources.finding: All top-level runs use the native executor; task personas spawn native child sessions; agent delegates to a named execution node over an authenticated control-plane socket; omp is a delegate driver; A2A peers separate.

sources.title: Configuration reference
sources.locator: [budgets]; max_concurrent_runs; cap on tool-using turns; LEMON_NODE_CAPABILITIES
sources.finding: TOML config with cumulative run/session token and dollar budgets (enforced, zero blocks), optional tool-turn cap, max_concurrent_runs, routing and provider settings.

sources.title: Execution policy and authority context
sources.locator: Validated tool policies; Policy intersection; line ~85
sources.finding: Fail-closed tool policy with allow/deny/require_approval; later layers can narrow but not widen; states it is not an OS filesystem sandbox.

sources.title: Agent safety contract
sources.finding: Command guards are not a sandbox; egress control is tool-level not an OS network sandbox; the helper is not a sandbox and every Bot and subprocess shares the host user.

sources.title: Telemetry
sources.finding: Only :telemetry (local, fire-and-forget) plus a persisted local introspection store; no external analytics SDK listed.

sources.title: Error reporting
sources.finding: Optional Sentry sink for unhandled exceptions that is disabled unless SENTRY_DSN is set.

sources.title: Delegating to omp
sources.finding: omp (oh-my-pi) is a separate coding agent Lemon can start, monitor, steer, cancel and resume over omp --mode rpc, optionally in managed git worktrees; Lemon passes no provider credentials to it.

sources.title: Memory user guide
sources.finding: remember/recall tools with scoped owner/agent/profile memory and automatic relevant-memory blocks; browse sessions with run summaries.

sources.title: Context files
sources.finding: Lemon loads CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, CLAUDE.local.md and .claude/.lemon variants as project context.

sources.title: Lemon in Tern
sources.finding: Lemon TUI renders on Tern native surfaces, with ACP chat and editor-location cards.

sources.title: Web workspace guide
sources.finding: Browser workspace with sessions, tool cards, diffs, usage (spend and tokens by model/provider/session for 1/7/30 days) and responsive phone width.

sources.title: Install guide
sources.finding: Releases for Apple Silicon macOS and Linux (glibc 2.39+); macOS Intel and native Windows have no release builds.

sources.title: Lemon Bot README
sources.finding: Lemon Bot is a separate Bun/TypeScript product: backend (SQLite, OIDC/SCIM adapters, MCP /mcp, push), React web, SwiftUI macOS and iOS apps; each Bot owned by one human and assigned a machine; groups coordinate 2-6 Bots.

sources.title: Lemon Bot API contract
sources.locator: §2 Accounts and ACL; OIDC routes (~1893); invite roles
sources.finding: Local same-OS-user sign-in, owner/admin/member workspace roles that never grant access to another user Bot, invite tokens, OIDC provider routes with requireSSO, device pairing for iPhone.

sources.title: Lemon Bot Apple clients
sources.finding: SwiftUI macOS and iOS clients; Developer ID DMG pending credentials and App Store iOS distribution via release.py; build from source today.

sources.title: Kanban store
sources.locator: task fields status, priority, assignee, depends_on; lease/reclaim
sources.finding: Durable kanban boards and tasks with status columns, priority, assignee, depends_on, leases and reclaim, archive.

sources.title: Kanban coding workflow
sources.finding: Opt-in leased coding then independent review then exact-tree commit then optional publication (push/PR never implicit); restart recovery keeps lease and run IDs; a second review rejection blocks the card.

sources.title: Kanban worktree
sources.finding: Per-task git worktree working directory for git-backed boards.

sources.title: Cron manager
sources.finding: Supervised cron scheduler in lemon_automation running isolated forked sessions with audit trail.

sources.title: Reminders and heartbeats
sources.finding: Cron expressions and intervals, /heartbeat jobs delivered to Telegram, goals and kanban automation guidance.

sources.title: Goal loop
sources.finding: Persistent goal loop with continuation budget and a judge tick (preview).

sources.title: Control-plane reference
sources.finding: Authenticated WebSocket JSON-RPC control plane used by TUI and clients: sessions, runs, approvals, config, usage, cron, kanban, nodes.

sources.title: A2A peers
sources.finding: Optional separate A2A listener on 9901 for authenticated peer agents exchanging durable tasks; not an execution node.
